name: Create Undead — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Create Undead from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Create Undead" but are not part of the Create Undead entry, which is unchanged.

Caster Level	Undead Created	Additional Requirements
11th (or lower)	Ghoul
11th (or lower)	Hollow helm	Corpse must be wearing suit of heavy armor
11th+	Huecuva 1	Corpse of a cleric (preferably an evil cleric)
11th+	Crawling hand	Severed hand of a Medium or smaller humanoid
11th+	Juju zombie4	Enervation or energy drain
11th+	Skeletal champion4	Enervation or energy drain
12th-14th	Ghast, festrog 2
12th+	Draugr
12th+	Guardian phantom armor	Corpse must be wearing suit of heavy armor
13th	Attic whisperer	Crushing despair, fear, corpse of a humanoid child
14th+	Blast shadow 3
14th+	Crawling hand (giant)	Enlarge person, severed hand of a Large or larger humanoid
14th+	Wight	Enervation
15th+	Giant phantom armor	Corpse must be wearing suit of heavy armor
15th-17th	Mummy
15th+	Crypt thing	Teleport
16th+	Phantom lancer	Humanoid corpse must be wearing suit of heavy armor; mount must be wearing barding

Caster Level	Undead Created	Additional Requirements
15th or lower	Shadow
15th+	Allip	Insanity
16th-17th	Wraith
18th+	Totenmaske	Caster must be a cleric
18th-19th	Spectre
19th	Bonestorm 5
19th	Greater shadow	Shadow walk
19th	Witchfire	Corpse of a hag
20th+	Banshee	Fear, wail of the banshee, corpse of a female elf
